name: Nelson Rigg CL-1060ST Sport Touring Tail Bag
source_title: Nelson Rigg CL-1060ST Sport Touring Tail Bag
description: Nelson Rigg CL-1060ST Sport Touring Tail Bag • Perfect size for day rides. • Easily mounts to most tail sections and directly to the seat for a clean look. • New self-adjusting hooks attach to bag with soft ties connecting to bike. • Made from top quality Tri-Max ballistic nylon with Fibertech accents.
source_description_html:
Nelson Rigg CL-1060ST Sport Touring Tail Bag

The Nelson Rigg CL-1060-ST Sport Touring Motorcycle Seat Bag features an expansion zipper that transforms the bag from a sleek pack to one that is capable of swallowing a full face helmet when you park your bike. Under-lid storage provides easy access to frequently used items.

Features:

  • Perfect size for day rides
  • Easily mounts to most tail sections and directly to the seat for a clean look
  • New self-adjusting hooks attach to bag with soft ties connecting to bike
  • Made from top quality Tri-Max ballistic nylon with Fibertech accents
  • Bag maintains shape, has reflective piping and a lined interior
  • High-density rubber zipper pulls operate easily with gloves
  • Adjustable compartment divider for better storage options
  • Reverse coil zippers helps keep out dust and dirt,  keeping zippers working smoothly
  • Mesh pocket and organizer under lid
  • Flush mount reflective carry handle
  • Converts into a convenient backpack using the shoulder strap which doubles as backpacks straps
  • Protective material prevents slipping or marking
  • Fully expandable and can hold a full face helmet
  • Includes a Lifetime "No Hassle” warranty and removable rain cover
  • Main compartment measures: 14” L x 12” W x 9” H / 12” H expanded
  • Holds 25 Liters / 33 Liters expanded
